title: B12 linear-invariant and floating-point accumulation diagnosis
question: Is the B12 storage-only Heun-to-oracle exception caused by floating-point loss of the exact linear water invariant during repeated state accumulation rather than by a different continuous-time Layer-ROM solution?

scope.boundary: zero top flux; fixed zero bottom pressure head

invariant.reason: top exchange is exactly zero in this laboratory
invariant.diagnostic_sum: math.fsum for float64 trajectory to separate state-invariant drift from ordinary summation-order error

routes.definition: same iterative Heun formula and same float64 constitutive/RHS evaluation, but y, predictor/corrector additions and cumulative bookkeeping are accumulated in numpy.longdouble; no flux formula changes
same B1HCI DOP853 oracle, rtol=1e-11, atol=1e-13, max_step=0.001 d

output_vector: RMS and max absolute total-storage difference to DOP853
RMS and max absolute fsum linear-invariant residual
RMS ordinary-sum minus fsum total-storage diagnostic
RMS storage-error decomposition into invariant drift minus cumulative-exchange error

confirmed_if: For HEUN_FLOAT64 at dt=2.5e-5 d, cumulative-bottom RMS to DOP853 <= 1e-12 cm.
For HEUN_FLOAT64 at dt=2.5e-5 d, mapped-theta RMS to DOP853 <= 1e-13.
The RMS linear-invariant error difference relative to DOP853 is at least 0.80 times the RMS storage error to DOP853.
At dt=2.5e-5 d, HEUN_EXTENDED_ACCUM reduces both storage RMS to DOP853 and invariant RMS by at least a factor 4 relative to HEUN_FLOAT64.

The ordinary np.sum versus math.fsum storage diagnostic is smaller than 0.25 times the HEUN_FLOAT64 invariant RMS, so the dominant effect is state accumulation rather than final diagnostic summation order.
decision_gate.note: These are numerical mechanism gates only. They do not define hydrological acceptance.

interpretation_rules: If confirmed, treat the B1HCI B12 exception as research-integrator floating-point accumulation at the numerical floor. Do not modify hydrological closure/state.
If not confirmed, keep finite-Reference refinement and model redesign held and investigate the B12 ODE/integrator mechanism further.
Even if confirmed, application fidelity remains unadjudicated.
